comment: Every 0.1.22 compat-table entry (the plugin's instant.json + the built-in /status, callbacks.json) as a tg-bind row, in menu order. Load with `tg-bind import ops/rollout/tg-bind-seed.json` (idempotent). Menu lines and toasts come from the tools registry (schemas/tools.toml).

rows.why: /status shows the status board at once, no brain turn; a failure goes to me as his message (0.1.6 built-in)
/bills: open and upcoming bills, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/queue: what's downloading in Sonarr/Radarr, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/space: server disk space and the fill-up forecast, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/reminders: his upcoming reminders, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/list: his lists, HA shopping list first, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/shop: the shopping plan by shop, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/parcels: the parcels card; '/parcels picked' marks a station pickup, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/gym: the next gym session and the coach views, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/cat: the cat week card, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/train: the next train legs with live status, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/gohome: the way home: next connections and the last one tonight, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/rave: upcoming shows and lineups of his artists, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/trip: the next trip card, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/warranty: what is still under warranty, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/back: the catch-up card after time away, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/week: the week ahead, one line per day, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/pack: the packing list for the next event, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/vibe: library picks for a mood, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/finish: started shows, closest to the end first, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/doctor: why a media request isn't on Emby yet, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/party: party lights on, off or status, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/crate: saves the playing track to the crate, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/usage: feature usage of the last 30 days, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/sleep: sleep and energy, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/waiting: what's waiting on him, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/night: what I did overnight, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
/traces: cost, reply speed and errors of the last 24 h, answered at once by the adapter; I get a short note
📞 Talk under the board and on event cards rings him at once through the voice relay
reminder buttons (snooze, done) act at once without a brain turn
Fixed on the vacuum fault card resumes the daily runs at once
